main_text.p: tenerent, veritatemque defenderent, Romanæque Ecclesiæ iudicium sequerentur, foras Legatorum Romanorum iussu eiecti sunt. Id ipsum in Photiana Synodo agnitum quoque fuit, illud suggerente Petro Cardinali, quamuis non obseruatum. Καὶ χαίρομεν δὲ ἐπὶ τούτῳ, ὅτι εἰς τὸ [?] Συνοδικὸν [?] οἱ ἀρχιερατικοὶ ἅπαντες συνυδόκησαν [?] Θεσμοὶ μὲν τῇ [?] κυρίᾳ, καὶ [?] διαπότης [?] ἡμῶν [?] τῷ οἰκουμενικῷ Πάπα. καὶ τῷ ἐκείνῳ ὡς κεφαλῇ πασῶν τῆς Ἐκκλησιῶν, καὶ ὅπερ ὠφέλει ποιῆσαι, καὶ ἐξακολουθεῖν τῇ ἁγιωτάτῃ τῆς Ῥωμαίων Ἐκκλησίᾳ πεποιήκασι τὸ πνεῦμα τὸ ἅγιον τὸ συνδοκιμάσαντων [?]. Et gaudemus de hoc, quod in hanc unionem, qui Archieraticiis sedibus præsident, omnes una simul approbarunt, cum Domino nostro Papa Oecumenico. Namque illa est Ecclesiarum omnium caput, & quod illi debebant agere, sequi nempe sanctissimam Romanam Ecclesiam, peregerunt, Spiritu sancto simul assensum præbente. Photiani nihilominus in hac Synodo ab auctoritate Romani sese subtrahentes, quæ illis complacent, exequuntur, quæ displicent reprobant, licet mellitis verborum globulis menti Pontificis obsecundari videantur. quo sane nihil excogitari potest immanius.
Adde præterea & illa ex Actione prima. Ἠλίας ὁ Θεσσαλονίκης [?] ὀρθοβούτεως, ὁ τοποτηρη-τὴς [?] Ἐξαρχολύμων εἶπε. ἐγὼ γὰρ ἐνχαριστῆσαι ἄξιον τῆς Θεῷ

page.notes: The Greek passages are set in italic and are the least certain part of this transcription; several words are marked [?] where the scan is too faint or too small to read reliably. The printed Greek should be checked against another copy before use. Long s is written as plain s throughout. The first word of "Namque" carries an ornamental N, which is copied as N. No printed marginal notes, running head or signature appear on this page.
